   271  
   272  section CompleteLattice
   273  variable [CompleteLattice α]
   274  
   275  open Set Function

   277  /-- An independent set of elements in a complete lattice is one in which every element is disjoint
   278    from the `Sup` of the rest. -/
   279  def sSupIndep (s : Set α) : Prop :=
   280    ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ s → Disjoint a (sSup (s \ {a}))
   281  
   282  variable {s : Set α} (hs : sSupIndep s)
   283  
   284  @[simp]
   285  theorem sSupIndep_empty : sSupIndep (∅ : Set α) := fun x hx =>
   286    (Set.notMem_empty x hx).elim
   287  
   288  include hs in
   289  theorem sSupIndep.mono {t : Set α} (hst : t ⊆ s) : sSupIndep t := fun _ ha =>
   290    (hs (hst ha)).mono_right (sSup_le_sSup (sdiff_subset_sdiff_left hst))
   291  
   292  include hs in
   293  /-- If the elements of a set are independent, then any pair within that set is disjoint. -/
   294  theorem sSupIndep.pairwiseDisjoint : s.PairwiseDisjoint id := fun _ hx y hy h =>
   295    disjoint_sSup_right (hs hx) ((mem_sdiff y).mpr ⟨hy, h.symm⟩)
   296  
   297  theorem sSupIndep_singleton (a : α) : sSupIndep ({a} : Set α) := fun i hi ↦ by
   298    simp_all
   299  
   300  theorem sSupIndep_pair {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) :
   301      sSupIndep ({a, b} : Set α) ↔ Disjoint a b := by
   302    constructor
   303    · intro h
   304      exact h.pairwiseDisjoint (mem_insert _ _) (mem_insert_of_mem _ (mem_singleton _)) hab
   305    · rintro h c ((rfl : c = a) | (rfl : c = b))
   306      · convert! h using 1
   307        simp [hab, sSup_singleton]
   308      · convert! h.symm using 1
   309        simp [hab, sSup_singleton]
   310  
   311  include hs in

   314  theorem sSupIndep.disjoint_sSup {x : α} {y : Set α} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ⊆ s) (hxy : x ∉ y) :
   315      Disjoint x (sSup y) := by
   316    have := (hs.mono <| insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hx, hy⟩) (mem_insert x _)
